cases.query: Household chores keep turning into one huge impossible task. How can I reduce the load?
Clothing seams, labels, pressure or fabric feel unbearable. What variables can I change?
I communicate more clearly in writing than in live speech. How can I make that preference usable?
I am struggling to stay in work and performance concerns have started. How can I separate support needs from the formal process?
Exams or timed assessments create disability-related barriers. What can I ask my school, college or university about?
Budgeting and keeping track of money is hard for me. What can I use without handing over financial decisions?
Sound, light, temperature or other sensory input is keeping me awake. What can I change before assuming it is a medical sleep disorder?
Food textures, smells, tastes or the eating environment make eating hard. What can I inspect?
Hospital appointments or admissions are hard because of disability or neurodivergent needs. What reasonable-adjustment questions can I prepare?
I need urgent mental-health help in the UK. Where should I go instead of trying to solve the crisis here?
I need disability-related help on public transport. What assistance and accessibility information can I inspect before travelling?
Before installing another app, what built-in accessibility settings can I inspect on Windows, Android or iPhone?
How can I look for a local neurodivergent peer group without the Oracle pretending every group is safe or a good fit?
There are many books and media about neurodivergence. How can I narrow what is relevant without asking the Oracle for a single 'best' one?
I need information about a medicine, side effects or an upcoming medication review. What can I prepare without changing my dose myself?
I have heard about ARFID and some of it sounds familiar. How can I learn about it without the Oracle diagnosing me?
I disagree with a benefit decision. How do I find the right reconsideration, re-determination or appeal process in the UK?
